title: MCP switch tool auto-switches global account on substring match
description:
Severity: Medium. Confidence: High (code) / Medium (depends on client auto-approval). Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/MCPServer.swift:113-116 (switch annotations), :97 and :103 (list/get annotations); Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:111 (substring match).

Scenario: prompt injection in content Claude reads (a README, an issue) makes it call switch_github_account("acme"); a unique substring is enough. The tool is annotated destructiveHint:false, idempotentHint:true, so a client may not prompt. The global gh account and ~/.gitconfig change, and the next git push / gh pr create from any terminal runs as the wrong account. list/get are annotated readOnlyHint:true, openWorldHint:false but make network calls (gh api user) and write config.json.

Fix: annotate switch destructiveHint:true; require exact login/label/host-login on the MCP surface (resolve allowPartial:false); set openWorldHint:true on list/get.
close_reason: MCP switch now exact-only (allowPartial:false); annotated destructiveHint:true, openWorldHint:true; list/get openWorldHint:true. Tests: mcpSwitchTool, mcpSwitchIsMarkedDestructive.

title: Inherited GH_TOKEN/GH_HOST can poison cached profiles and git identity
description:
Severity: Medium. Confidence: Medium (gh docs say GH_TOKEN takes precedence over stored credentials; runtime check not yet run). Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Clients.swift:31-38; Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:87-93; Sources/GHSwitchCore/Shell.swift:27.

Scenario: GH_TOKEN/GH_HOST are inherited from the environment (shell, Claude). gh auth token --user X may return the same env token for every account, so /user returns one identity. That is cached permanently under every account key (userID is never refreshed), and each switch writes the wrong user.name and noreply email into ~/.gitconfig. GHUser.login is decoded but never compared with the requested login.

Verify: GH_TOKEN=dummy gh auth token --hostname github.com --user <other-login> (prints "dummy" => confirmed).

Fix: skip enrichment unless user.login equals account.login (case-insensitive); strip GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN, GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN and GH_HOST from the child environment for gh calls.
close_reason: All gh calls unset GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN/GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN/GH_HOST; empty token rejected; /user login must match (loginMismatch). Tests: ghIgnoresInheritedToken, mismatchedApiLoginIsRejected.

title: Add a LICENSE: repo is public but not open source
description:
Severity: Medium. Confidence: High. Source: open-sourcing.

RiskResponse/gh-switcher is already public but has no LICENSE file, so legally nobody may reuse it.

Fix: add LICENSE (Apache-2.0 or MIT) and a License section in README.md.
close_reason: Added MIT LICENSE and README License section.

title: Switch to non-github.com host leaves previous user.email
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Models.swift:117-122; Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:59-60.

Scenario: switching to a GHES / non-github.com account with no custom gitEmail updates user.name but leaves the previous account's user.email, so work commits carry a personal email or vice versa.

Fix: unset user.email, or refuse and warn, when no email can be derived.
close_reason: switchTo unsets user.email when no email is known; CLI/MCP say so. Test: switchToEnterpriseUnsetsStaleEmail.

title: Corrupt config.json silently resets settings and wipes profiles
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Clients.swift:81-84 (ConfigStore.load); writers at Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:73 and :96.

Scenario: config.json becomes undecodable (hand edit, future schema change). load() returns Config() defaults, so updateGitIdentity flips back to true even though the user disabled it. The next switch rewrites the global git identity, and the next save erases all labels and custom name/email.

Fix: distinguish missing from corrupt; on corrupt, throw, refuse to save, and keep a backup.
close_reason: ConfigStore.load throws invalidConfig unless the file is missing; app/CLI/MCP stop instead of saving defaults. Test: configStoreDefaultsOnlyWhenMissing.

title: Gitignore audit output (.gstack/, audit-context/)
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: open-sourcing.

.gstack/security-reports/ and audit-context/ are untracked and not in .gitignore. A git add . would publish detailed audit notes to the public repo.

Fix: add both to .gitignore or move them out of the repo.

title: Add timeout to Shell.run (MCP loop can hang)
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Shell.swift:39-50; Sources/GHSwitchCore/MCPServer.swift:13-20.

Scenario: gh api user hangs on the network and the single-threaded MCP loop stops answering every tool call; there is no subprocess timeout.

Fix: add a timeout that terminates the subprocess.
close_reason: Shell.run has a 30s default timeout that terminates the child and throws timedOut. Test: shellRunTimesOut.

title: security-review workflow: PR-supplied Claude config runs with secrets
description:
Severity: Low (High if the fork guard is removed or the trigger becomes pull_request_target). Confidence: Low. Source: agentic-actions-auditor.

Location: .github/workflows/security-review.yml:16-25; anthropics/claude-code-security-review@0c6a49f claudecode/github_action_audit.py:237.

Scenario: the action runs claude with cwd = the PR head checkout. A PR can add .claude/settings.json hooks or allow rules (this repo now ships a .claude/settings.json SessionStart hook from bd init), CLAUDE.md or .mcp.json, which run with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a pull-requests:write GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment. PR title/body/diff also go straight into the prompt. The fork guard limits this to people with push access, who can already edit the workflow.

Fix: keep the guard; check out into a subdirectory or delete .claude/, CLAUDE.md and .mcp.json before the scan step; watch upstream for a hardened release.
close_reason: security-review workflow deletes .claude, .mcp.json, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .agents, .codex, .cursor from the PR checkout before Claude runs. Fork guard kept.

title: remove: no CLI confirmation and no rollback after logout
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:66-80; Sources/gh-switch/main.swift:60-62.

Scenario: an agent with shell access runs gh-switch rm work and the token is deleted with no prompt. Any step after gh auth logout (config save, re-query, switchTo) can throw, so the user sees an error although the logout already happened. The next active account is picked across all hosts.

Fix: require confirmation or --yes in the CLI; report partial state; choose the next account on the same host.
close_reason: CLI remove asks (or needs --yes when non-interactive); flags no longer parsed as the account; post-logout failures throw partiallyRemoved; next active account chosen on the same host. Test: removeReportsPartialFailureAfterLogout.

title: install-desktop: single backup, replaces symlinks, races Claude
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: Medium. Source: audit-context, sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Clients.swift:125-149.

Scenario: running install-desktop twice overwrites the only .gh-switch.bak. The atomic write replaces a symlinked (dotfiles-managed) claude_desktop_config.json with a plain file. It can race with Claude Desktop rewriting the same file. Read errors other than "missing" are collapsed into an empty config.

Fix: timestamped backups; resolve symlinks before writing; warn if Claude is running; treat only ENOENT as "no config".
close_reason: install-desktop writes through symlinks, keeps timestamped backups, treats only a missing file as empty, warns when Claude is running. Test: desktopInstallWritesThroughSymlink.

title: security-review action installs unpinned claude-code on Node 18
description:
Severity: Low. Confidence: High. Source: agentic-actions-auditor, open-sourcing.

Location: anthropics/claude-code-security-review action.yml:161 (Node 18) and :171 (npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code, unpinned).

Scenario: the action is SHA-pinned, but it installs the latest claude-code from npm at runtime on end-of-life Node 18. A compromised npm release would run with the API key available.

Fix: accept and monitor upstream; add Dependabot for github-actions so the SHA pin stays current.
close_reason: Added .github/dependabot.yml (github-actions, 7-day cooldown) to keep the action SHA current. The action's unpinned npm install of claude-code is upstream and can't be pinned from here.

title: Log resolved gh/git binary paths (PATH-first lookup)
description:
Severity: Info. Confidence: High. Source: sharp-edges, insecure-defaults (refuted: no trust boundary crossed).

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Shell.swift:12-21.

The app (launchd PATH), MCP server (Claude's PATH) and CLI (shell PATH) can resolve different gh binaries. Every searched directory is user- or root-owned.

Fix (optional): log or display the resolved path.
close_reason: gh-switch current prints the resolved gh and git paths.

title: Whitespace-only label plus "@" query exact-matches an account
description:
Severity: Info. Confidence: High. Source: sharp-edges.

Location: Sources/GHSwitch/ManageView.swift:134; Sources/GHSwitchCore/Switcher.swift:102-106.

A whitespace-only label is stored (only isEmpty is checked), and the MCP query "@" normalizes to "" and exact-matches that account. Note: "".contains is false with Foundation, so "@" does not fuzzy-match every account.

Fix: trim labels before saving; reject an empty normalized query in resolve.
close_reason: resolve rejects an empty normalized query and ignores blank labels; ManageView trims label/name/email before saving. Test: emptyQueryNeverMatchesBlankLabel.

title: MCP errors forward raw stderr and full login list to the model
description:
Severity: Info. Confidence: High. Source: sharp-edges, insecure-defaults (refuted as a vulnerability: same user only).

Location: Sources/GHSwitchCore/Models.swift:13-18; Sources/GHSwitchCore/MCPServer.swift:78.

Raw gh/git stderr and every login go into the model's context and transcript.

Fix: return short messages over MCP; keep full detail for the CLI.
close_reason: MCP errors use GHSwitchError.mcpDescription: no gh/git stderr, no list of all logins.

title: Repo hygiene: SECURITY.md, Dependabot, branch protection
description:
Severity: Info. Confidence: High. Source: open-sourcing.

Missing: SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING, Dependabot/Renovate, semver release tags, branch protection. The wiki is enabled.

Fix: add SECURITY.md and enable private vulnerability reporting; enable secret scanning and push protection; add Dependabot for github-actions; protect main.
close_reason: Added SECURITY.md and Dependabot. Enabled private vulnerability reporting, secret scanning + push protection, disabled wiki, protected main (PR required, no force push/deletion). Not done: CONTRIBUTING, release tags.
